clue.text: Leave, determined to go on Scottish river

indicators.note: the river's name is to go on after the first piece, placed next in the answer

parts.note: set means fixed or determined, as in set on a plan
the Forth flows past Stirling into the Firth of Forth by Edinburgh

explanation.surface: Someone resolved to set off and travel along a Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: To set forth is to depart on a journey, a synonym of leave as a verb.

clue.text: Country holding alternative view

indicators.note: holding means the country's name contains the other piece

parts.note: Panama is the Central American country
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A nation offers an alternative outlook on things.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide, sweeping view of a landscape, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Disorganised brawl — nobody's to be charged

definitions.meaning: a chaotic fight in which everyone joins in
read literally, no one has to pay: costing nothing for everybody

explanation.surface: A messy fight where, happily, no one ends up facing charges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' reads as arrested after the brawl, but the second sense is about paying a price.
explanation.definitionFit: A free-for-all is an unruly melee, and literally means without cost to anyone.

clue.text: Material's marvellous, very amusing mostly

parts.note: fab is informal for fabulous, marvellous

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, its final letter dropped

parts.note: rich, as in 'that's rich', means highly amusing

explanation.surface: Someone praises a material as wonderful and quite hilarious.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is cloth, a textile material from which clothes are made.

clue.text: Row of bushes, height not shown, forming border

indicators.note: not shown means that letter is left out of the word

parts.note: a hedge is a line of closely planted shrubs

explanation.surface: A low hedge is planted to mark the edge of a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: An edge is the boundary or margin of something, a synonym of border.

clue.text: Ardent admirer attends, on the way up, a Disney film

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiastic devotee

indicators.note: in a down clue, on the way up means these letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: is at means is present at, attends

explanation.surface: A devoted fan goes to see a classic Disney picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way up' turns IS AT into TASI.
explanation.definitionFit: Fantasia is the 1940 Disney animated feature set to classical music.

clue.text: Look forward to a sauce, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a condiment such as chutney or pickle; perhaps marks a sauce as one example

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly anticipates a sauce at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: To relish is to enjoy in anticipation; a relish is also a tangy condiment.

clue.text: Tail of gull caught, apparently — or another bird

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its final letter

parts.note: something caught might seem to be in a net; apparently flags this playful reading

explanation.surface: A gull's tail feather is snagged, or perhaps it was some other bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A linnet is a small brown finch, a bird different from the gull.

clue.text: Nothing about English verse where 23 Down is

indicators.note: about means the first word goes around the others

parts.note: nada is Spanish for nothing, used in English slang

explanation.surface: No English poetry is to be found in a certain place.
explanation.walkthrough: 23 Down is the gambling city in the west of the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: Reno, the gambling city, lies in the western US state of Nevada.

clue.text: The criminal underworld in Georgia, country without leadership

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

indicators.note: without leadership means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: England is the country

explanation.surface: Organised crime flourishes in Georgia, a nation lacking proper rulers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country without leadership' looks like a lament about government; it means ENGLAND loses its E.
explanation.definitionFit: Gangland is the world of organised gangs and their crime, the criminal underworld.

clue.text: Certainly love loud passage

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
F is forte, the musical direction for loud
a course is a route or passage, as of a river

explanation.surface: Someone confidently affirms their love of a noisy corridor.
explanation.definitionFit: Of course is an emphatic yes, meaning certainly or naturally.

clue.text: Response from a king receiving bad news

indicators.note: bad means these letters are spoiled into a new order

parts.note: R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A monarch replies after hearing grim tidings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' signals the scrambling of the news; the king's single letter closes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An answer is a reply or response to a question or message.

clue.text: Shows wide pitches

parts.note: broad means wide
to cast is to throw or pitch

explanation.surface: A sports report shows wayward deliveries from a bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcasts are radio or television programmes, that is, shows.

clue.text: Small stem bearing flowers? Any number out of season

indicators.note: out of means that letter is removed from the season

parts.note: spring is a season of the year
N stands for any number in mathematics

explanation.surface: A flowering twig appears at an odd time, unseasonally.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig is a small shoot or twig of a plant, often with leaves or blossom.

clue.text: Pitiful male going to pieces swamping craft

indicators.note: swamping means engulfing, so the other piece sits inside

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
breaking means coming apart, going to pieces
art is skill or craft

explanation.surface: A sad scene: a man falls apart as his boat is overwhelmed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitiful' here means pitiable, arousing pity, not contemptible.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heartbreaking causes deep grief, so it is pitiful or distressing.

clue.text: Wrong French river for this reptile

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
the Oise is a river of northern France

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly names a French river as this creature's home.
explanation.definitionFit: A tortoise is a slow land reptile with a domed shell.

clue.text: Encroach on one northern border

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a fringe is an edge or border

explanation.surface: Someone trespasses onto a single northern frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: To infringe on rights is to encroach on them, intruding where one has no right.

clue.text: French wine consumed by Norwegian composer in mourning

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside the composer's name

parts.note: Edvard Grieg wrote the Peer Gynt music
vin is French for wine

explanation.surface: A Norwegian composer drinks French wine while in mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: Grieving means sorrowing over a loss, in a state of mourning.

clue.text: Good aquanaut's beginning to follow injured blue whale

indicators.note: to follow means these letters come after the rearranged colour
injured means the letters of the colour are damaged into a new order
beginning means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A diver follows a wounded blue whale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' turns BLUE into BELU, followed by G and A.
explanation.definitionFit: The beluga is a small white Arctic whale.

clue.text: Get on with head of corporation in New York office

parts.note: to age is to get on in years

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the city's abbreviation
head of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Advice to get along with the boss of a company at a New York workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: An agency is a business or bureau, an office providing a service.

clue.text: Scruffy kid, kid with a cake

parts.note: to rag is to tease, or kid
a muffin is a small cake

explanation.surface: An untidy child is eating a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'kid' is a verb, to tease, not a child.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragamuffin is a child in ragged, dirty clothes.

clue.text: Copper, say, reportedly showing courage

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is as heard, a sound-alike

parts.note: copper is one example of a metal

explanation.surface: A police officer, it is said, shows bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Mettle is spirit and resilience, a synonym of courage.

clue.text: Significance of women's rowing crew

parts.note: W abbreviates women
an eight is a racing boat crewed by eight rowers

explanation.surface: The importance of a women's boat crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Weight means importance or influence, as in carrying weight.

clue.text: Rescue from turbulent River Tees, when docked

indicators.note: turbulent means the remaining letters are churned into a new order
docked means cut short, the last letter removed

explanation.surface: Someone is saved from a rough river in north-east England after a boat moors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'docked' drops the S from RIVER TEES; 'turbulent' rearranges RIVERTEE. The Tees is a river in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrieve is to recover or get back, to rescue from a bad place.

clue.text: Northern half of famous gambling centre

indicators.note: in a down entry the northern half is the top half, the first four letters

parts.note: renowned means famous

explanation.surface: The north side of a well-known casino city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Northern' seems to describe the city, but in a down clue it means the upper half of RENOWNED.
explanation.definitionFit: Reno in Nevada is famed for its casinos, a gambling city.

clue.text: Try fish an American way

parts.note: a turn is a go or try
the pike is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An invitation to go fishing in the American manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way' looks like a method; it is a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnpike is a US toll highway, a road or way.

clue.text: Key member, close

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
an end is a close or conclusion

explanation.surface: An important member is nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' looks like an adjective, important; it is a noun, the table on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: A legend on a map or chart is the key explaining its symbols.

clue.text: Real money splashed about acquiring foremost of buildings in London area

indicators.note: acquiring means the rearranged letters take in another letter
money splashed about is scattered freely, so these letters are thrown into a new order
foremost of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Cash is spent lavishly on property in a part of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'splashed about' makes MARYLEONE from REAL MONEY, and B goes inside. Marylebone is a district of central London.
explanation.definitionFit: Marylebone is a district in the City of Westminster, central London.
